name: Spire Heritage Society Ancestral Sash
description:
A formal sash worn diagonally across the torso, displaying the wearer's verified genealogical lineage through a sequence of embroidered family crests and corponation association symbols. The sash is issued by the Spire Heritage Society after a genealogical audit that costs more than most Shelf residents earn in a year. Each generation of verified lineage adds one crest.

The Ancestral Sash is worn at formal events to establish social hierarchy based on bloodline rather than achievement. In Spire social mathematics, old money outranks new money, and the sash quantifies exactly how old your claim to status really is.
functionality: Lineage display, social hierarchy establishment, heritage verification
what_it_says: Your family has been powerful long enough to prove it, and this sash makes sure everyone in the room knows exactly how long.
story_hooks: An Ancestral Sash displayed at a gala contains a family crest that genealogical records show was fabricated — one generation of the wearer's lineage is fictional, and someone in the Heritage Society helped falsify it.
